body.statement: For every fixed \(M>0\), there exist constants \(0<c_M\le C_M<\infty\), depending only on \(M\), such that whenever \(LT\le M\) and \(L\max_k\Delta_k\le1\), \[c_ML^2\sum_{k=1}^K\Delta_k^2\le\sup_{\mathbf z:\mathcal M(\mathbf z)\ne\varnothing}W(\mathbf z)\le C_ML^2\sum_{k=1}^K\Delta_k^2.\] The lower bound is attained in order by compatible positive-cell pulse laws, and the upper bound holds over all measurable compatible hazard quadruples.
body.justification: The matched modulus separates deterministic causal information loss from statistical error and gives an inspection-frequency design criterion.
body.gap: StensrudHernanTchetgenRobinsDidelezYoung2021 states only that temporal ordering becomes less important on fine grids, while GroeneboomMaathuisWellner2008 and MaathuisHudgens2011 study sampling rates for factual subdistributions rather than this adversarial causal identification width.
body.consumer: Trial analysts can choose an inspection mesh that guarantees the worst compatible separable-risk ambiguity is below a prespecified clinical tolerance.
